outcome: Type of third stage of labor
cohort: Women who requested a homebirth at a large metropolitan health service in Victoria, Australia between 2009-2019
finding: Women who had a homebirth were significantly more likely to be multiparous, have a normal vaginal birth and an intact perineum, less likely to require suturing and less likely to have blood loss of more than 500 mL.
mod_finding: Women who had a homebirth were significantly more likely to have a normal vaginal birth.
